say:4:1522024002:0.text: T-The... G-Gilded Serpent must be behind this! It k-knows we're after it!
say:4:1522024002:0.source_cn: 这……这一定是金……金鳞蛇皇在作祟！它知道我们要抓……...
say:4:1522024002:0.male: T-The... G-Gilded Serpent must be behind this! It k-knows we're after it!
say:4:1522024002:0.female: T-The... G-Gilded Serpent must be behind this! It k-knows we're after it!

say:5:1522024003:0.text: It m-must have used the divine power t-to summon the red ants and crocodiles!
say:5:1522024003:0.source_cn: 它有狩猎神的神力，所以才……才才……才会召唤赤蚁和鳄鱼！

say:7:1522024004:0.text: Red ants, crocodiles... who cares? The most important thing is we've got to catch that snake to keep our people safe!
say:7:1522024004:0.source_cn: 不管赤蚁和鳄鱼为什么出现，我们都必须把金鳞蛇皇抓住，才...

say:9:1522024005:1.text: So what now? Ya think we should fill up the whole swamp?
say:9:1522024005:1.source_cn: 那咋整？你想把整个沼泽都填上？

say:11:1522024007:0.text: How 'bout I go talk to Kordan, get him to send some folks to give us a hand?
say:11:1522024007:0.source_cn: 要不，俺就去找戈丹说，让他派人和俺们一起在沼泽里找，找...

say:12:1522024008:0.source_cn: 那太危险了，不能这么干！

say:13:1522024009:1.text: Can't do this, can't do that... Ya got a better plan, then?
say:13:1522024009:1.source_cn: 这也不行那也不行……那你们想怎么干？！

choice:6:0:1.text: ... Red ants are creations of the God of Harvest, by the way.

choice:6:0:1.female: ... Red ants are creations of the God of Harvest, by the way.

choice:6:1:2.text: Don't blow things out of proportion.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 没有你们想的那么可怕
choice:6:1:2.male: Don't blow things out of proportion.
choice:6:1:2.female: Don't blow things out of proportion.
